resources.string: Set up TV
Your TV, reclaimed
Less clutter.\nMore control.
A guided setup to keep your essentials, disable unwanted extras and choose a cleaner Home. No computer needed.
Choose what stays
Your apps, TV features and Home screen. Every change is reviewed first.
Save a recovery record
How every app was before setup, so it can all be put back. Not a full TV backup.
System changes carry risk

Apps are disabled, never uninstalled, and only from cleanyourtv\'s lists, tested by its community on real TVs. Still, a feature can stop working, and in rare cases recovery may need a factory reset. You use this at your own risk.
I understand the risks
Have the TV\'s remote ready: turning on debugging and approving this phone happen on the TV.
Continue
Turn on network debugging
On the TV, open Settings › System › About (on some TVs: Device Preferences › About).
Highlight “Build” (or “Android TV OS build”) and press the remote’s OK button seven times, until it says you’re a developer.
Go back to Settings › System › Developer options. Turn on USB debugging, and Network or ADB debugging if your TV shows it.
Find the TV’s IP address in Settings › Network & Internet, under your connection.
TV address

Keep the TV\'s Wi-Fi
These networks were saved by the TV\'s setup wizard, and switching it off deletes them. Enter each password and this phone saves them again on the TV first, so the TV stays online.
If a password is wrong, the TV drops off Wi-Fi. You\'d then have to join the network again with the TV\'s own remote, in Settings › Network & Internet.

Safer: do it on the TV
On the TV, open Settings › Network & Internet, forget the network and join it again. The setup wizard no longer owns it then, and nothing needs typing here. Then review again.
